name: Plan the release
description: A read-only release runbook (rollout, verification, rollback) saved as DEPLOY.md in the work's documents directory.

parameters.label: Where the work's documents are
parameters.description: The directory the earlier steps saved their documents in, e.g. {{scratch.dir}} for feature-flow.

parameters.label: What to read first
parameters.description: The documents that say what the change does, e.g. the design.

parameters.label: What the plan must cover
parameters.default: prerequisites (config, secrets, migrations, feature flags), the rollout order and any staged or canary rollout, how to verify it worked in each environment, the rollback plan and its trigger, and who needs to know

step.name: Plan the release
step.prompt:
Write the release plan for {{ticket.key}}: {{ticket.title}}. Read {{params.context}}.

Cover: {{params.cover}}. Do not change any files.

Your whole reply is saved as {{params.docs}}/DEPLOY.md; write it as that runbook.
